compatibility: BattINFO 0.7.0 imports electrochemistry 0.37.2 and chemical-substance 0.15.0, but this pinned union contains 0.31.1 and 0.12.3. Only EMMO core 1.0.2 terms are mapped; do not infer across the mixed-version imports.

entity_types.label: Process
entity_types.condition: A physical process, not a planning or administrative workflow.

entity_types.label: Material
entity_types.condition: A physical material, not an abstract material specification.

entity_types.label: Data
entity_types.condition: Actual data, not an unmeasured parameter or intended KPI.

entity_types.label: Artifact
entity_types.condition: A physical object; do not map software or abstract designs to Object.

entity_types.label: ResearchField
entity_types.reason: No reviewed equivalent in the pinned graph.

entity_types.label: Concept
entity_types.reason: Too broad for a single ontology class.

entity_types.label: Method
entity_types.reason: The similarly labeled BattINFO term is a record placeholder, not a domain class.

entity_types.label: Content
entity_types.reason: Publications and other content need separate review.

entity_types.label: Other
entity_types.reason: Fallback type cannot be mapped safely.

relations.label: causes
relations.note: Use only for an evidenced causal claim, not co-occurrence.

relations.label: affects
relations.reason: EMMO affects means a specific Process/Object overlap; PEM uses the word more broadly.

relations.label: influences
relations.reason: EMMO influences has Process/Object and causal-overlap semantics not guaranteed by a PEM label.

relations.label: results_in
relations.reason: An observed result does not by itself establish EMMO causation.

relations.label: precedes
relations.reason: EMMO precedes implies directed causal contact; a manufacturing order alone does not.

relations.label: produces
relations.condition: Only when the source is a physical process and the target its output; other senses of produces remain unmapped.

relations.label: uses
relations.reason: EMMO hasInput applies to process input, but PEM uses covers devices, methods and materials.

relations.label: part_of
relations.condition: Only true mereological part-whole claims, not membership in a study or association.

relations.label: contains
relations.condition: Only constituent part-whole, not spatial or informational containment.

relations.label: leads_to
relations.reason: A downstream association is not necessarily causal.

relations.label: follows
relations.reason: EMMO temporal relation has stronger causal semantics than sequence order.

relations.label: degrades
relations.reason: No reviewed equivalent with matching degradation semantics.

relations.label: increases
relations.reason: A signed quantitative effect needs a typed property and evidence.

relations.label: decreases
relations.reason: A signed quantitative effect needs a typed property and evidence.

relations.label: depends_on
relations.reason: Dependency is broader than material input or causation.

relations.label: requires
relations.reason: Requirement is not equivalent to a process input without typed context.

relations.label: used_for
relations.reason: Purpose is not the inverse of process input.

relations.label: occurs_in
relations.reason: Location or context is not mereological parthood.

relations.label: optimizes
relations.reason: Optimization needs an objective and measured outcome.

relations.label: supports
relations.reason: Support may mean evidence, enablement or assistance.

relations.label: studies
relations.reason: Research activity needs separately typed actor and subject.

relations.label: measures
relations.reason: Measurement relation needs an explicitly typed process, object or property.

relations.label: published_by
relations.reason: Publication provenance is outside the reviewed EMMO relation subset.

relations.label: authored_by
relations.reason: Authorship provenance is outside the reviewed EMMO relation subset.

relations.label: evidenced_by
relations.reason: Evidence provenance must retain chunk and document identifiers.

relations.label: described_in
relations.reason: Document attribution is not a physical containment relation.

relations.label: collaborates_with
relations.reason: Symmetric organization relation; no reviewed equivalent.

relations.label: compared_with
relations.reason: Comparison is not a causal or material relation.

relations.label: similar_to
relations.reason: Similarity requires a stated comparison basis.

relations.label: related_to
relations.reason: Generic fallback has no stable ontological meaning.

relations.label: associated_with
relations.reason: Generic association is not causal evidence.
